sn22.36:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā || pe || Ekam antam nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3
sn22.36:1.3: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahītatto vihareyyanti || || 4
sn22.36:1.4: Yaṃ kho bhikkhu anuseti tam anumīyati ||
sn22.36:1.7: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti || ||
sn22.36:2.1: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || 6
sn22.36:2.2: Rūpaṃ ce bhante anuseti tam anumīyati ||
sn22.36:2.9: Rūpaṃ ce bhante nānuseti na tam anumīyati ||
sn22.36:2.10: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkham gacchati ||
sn22.36:2.14: Viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na tam anumīyati ||
sn22.36:2.15: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.36:2.16: Imassa kho ham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti || || 8
sn22.36:3.2: sādhu kho tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || ||
sn22.36:3.3: Rūpaṃ ce bhikkhave anuseti tam anumīyati ||
sn22.36:3.10: Rūpaṃ ce bhikkhu nānuseti na tam anumīyati ||
sn22.36:3.11: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.36:3.16: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.36:3.17: Imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabo ti || || 9 Atha kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 10 Atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto ||pe || 11
sn22.36:3.18: Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahatam ahosīti || || 1
